description: Books an appointment for an existing customer (customer_id) or a new one (new_customer). Two steps: first call without confirm to get a preview and show it to the person; only after they agree, call again with the same arguments, confirm: true, the confirmation_token from the preview and an idempotency_key. Easy!Appointments then sends its usual confirmation emails.

confirm.description: Leave false (the default) to get a preview without changing anything. Set true only after the person has seen the preview and agreed.

confirmation_token.description: Required when confirm is true: the confirmation_token from the preview of exactly these arguments. It expires after a few minutes; if it has, get a new preview.

customer_id.description: An existing customer, from find_customer. Give this or new_customer.

idempotency_key.description: Required when confirm is true. Any unique string, for example a UUID. Reusing it with the same arguments returns the first result instead of acting twice.

new_customer.description: Details for someone not yet in the system. If the email already belongs to a customer, that customer is used. Some businesses also require phone, address, city or zip_code; the preview says which are missing.

start.description: Start time "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM" in the provider's time zone, exactly as find_open_slots returned it.

name: book_appointment
title: Book an appointment
